🌆 Market News Digest
[Nov 19, 2026, EST]

🔥 Top Stories
• Anthropic debuts in blowout IPO — $ANT opened at $111.50, closed at $97.17, still up 17% and near a $2T valuation; massive AI wealth effect, but enthusiasm faded intraday  
• Fed speakers turn more hawkish on AI-driven inflation — Goolsbee/Jefferson/Barr flagged persistent inflation, tariff pass-through and data-center demand as risks to a higher-for-longer rate path  
• U.S./China chip tensions escalate — House panel disclosed 3.4M advanced chip export applications to China; Nvidia/AMD licenses and approval process face fresh scrutiny  
• Mideast risk stays elevated — Iran/Hormuz tensions and Trump comments on Iran/Ukraine kept geopolitics front-and-center; oil rallied on supply fears then settled near flat  
• Cyberattack hits major U.S. payments names — Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan reported customer-data leakage via third-party vendors, pressuring financials and risk sentiment  

⛽ Oil & Energy
• WTI settled at $83.21, Brent at $91.98 as Hormuz headlines offset by no immediate supply shock  
• U.S. nat gas storage rose +20 Bcf vs +25 expected; diesel/gasoline prices also softened at settlement  

📊 Markets & Macro
• U.S. stocks sold off hard into the close: Dow -2.18%, S&P 500 -1.98%, Nasdaq -2.22%; VIX hit an ~8-month high  
• Jobless claims missed estimates and Philly Fed was weak, while Kansas City Fed was stronger — mixed macro but rates stayed elevated  
• Treasury yields rose; 10Y around 5.09% before easing, and the 10Y TIPS auction tailed slightly  
• U.S. leading indicators fell -0.3%, reinforcing slowing-growth concerns  
• Canadian and South African data stayed mixed; Canadian business confidence improved sharply  

🌍 Geopolitical
• Trump said talks with Xi and Putin were positive but Ukraine aid/peace terms remain uncertain; Berlin talks produced cautious optimism  
• Russia-Ukraine remains tense: Putin rejected foreign troops in Ukraine and warned of painful retaliation over the Crimean bridge  
• Iran said no nuclear talks until the Hormuz issue is resolved; reports also cited a tanker hit in eastern Hormuz  

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• FCC voted to bar Chinese telecom firms from direct access to U.S. phone numbers  
• EU moved to revise sustainable finance rules, including new fund categories and looser treatment for some fossil fuel exposure  
• Canada is seeking an interim U.S. tariff deal by year-end  

🏢 Corporate
• Walmart beat and raised guidance — revenue/EPS topped estimates and FY27 EPS guidance moved higher  
• Nvidia/Microsoft expanded AI partnership — Vera Rubin NVL72 systems headed to Azure; Microsoft also extending AI compute to Windows PCs  
• AMD sank on short report — Hunterbrook flagged China export-control risks; AMD denied misrepresentations but shares fell sharply  
• Meta is reworking its AI hardware push — betting on $300 Muse charm wearables while delaying smartwatch rollout  
• Ross Stores beat; Gap missed and guided lower — off-price retail held up better than apparel  
• Intuit beat and agreed to sell Mailchimp for $3.68B EV; P&G also flagged 20%-30% manufacturing workforce cuts by 2030
